entities.name: Noyan Dar
entities.description: A former lullmage turned roilmage who runs a retreat at Coralhelm training initiates to intensify the Roil against the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker seeking allies to fight the Eldrazi at Sea Gate; he is a nearly invulnerable armored warrior with glowing blades.

entities.name: Llura
entities.description: A roilmage initiate who leads the litany with a large smile.

entities.name: Roilmage initiates
entities.description: Noyan Dar's students at Coralhelm who chant the litany and work the Roil together as a force against the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Lullmages
entities.description: A tradition of wizards who learned to calm the fury of Zendikar and the Roil.

entities.name: Roil
entities.description: The unpredictable magical weather of Zendikar, which Noyan describes as a sneeze and a natural defense against the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Coralhelm
entities.description: A floating landmass ringed by a gorge and roped to the cliff edges, site of Noyan's roilmage retreat.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The city where Gideon is gathering allies to fight the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: The main continent of Zendikar, where the roilmages stage their demonstration.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane under assault by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Alien beings including scions, drones and larger creatures of Ulamog's lineage that have risen on Zendikar.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan whose direct lineage appears among the Eldrazi herd the roilmages fight.

entities.name: Ula
entities.description: One of the three gods of Noyan's people, the figure in a children's story about the ocean's sneeze.

entities.name: Cosi
entities.description: A trickster god in Noyan's people's stories who convinces Ula to do things for Cosi's benefit.

events.summary: Noyan Dar leads his initiates at Coralhelm in a deliberately dissonant litany meant to teach them to heighten the Roil.
A kitesailer's harness shears off in an updraft and his passenger falls hundreds of feet.
events.quote: his passenger plummeted to the ground hundreds of feet below.

events.summary: The falling man survives the impact in a flash of golden light and introduces himself as Gideon Jura, looking for Noyan.
events.quote: I'm Gideon Jura. I'm looking for the roilmage, Noyan Dar.

events.summary: Gideon asks for the roilmages' help at Sea Gate; Noyan objects that they are not elementalists and are in training.
events.quote: We need your help at Sea Gate.

events.summary: Noyan explains through the story of Ula and the sneeze that the Roil is the world's natural defense against the Eldrazi.
events.quote: The Roil built up over time as a natural defense against the presence of the Eldrazi.

events.summary: Llura leads the full litany, and Gideon, doubting the roilmages, is moved to say this may not have been a good idea.
events.quote: Maybe . . . maybe this was not a good idea,

events.summary: Angered, Noyan insists on a practical demonstration, and the group travels to Tazeem to find an Eldrazi herd.
events.quote: "A practical demonstration is in order," Noyan said. "I insist."

events.summary: The Eldrazi swarm toward Gideon and Noyan while the initiates spread in a wide circle.
events.quote: The Eldrazi slowly began swarming in the direction of Gideon and Noyan

events.summary: The initiates work the circle while Noyan gathers irritation into the Roil as Gideon holds the Eldrazi at bay.
events.quote: the large circle of earth surrounding Gideon and Noyan began to rotate in one direction and then the other.

events.summary: Noyan unleashes the Roil, collapsing the ground into a chasm that kills the Eldrazi horde and drops Gideon with it.
Gideon survives the fall, apologizes for his doubt and asks the roilmages to join the defense of Sea Gate.
events.quote: I am sorry, Noyan, for any doubt. That display was amazing.

events.summary: Noyan agrees that the roilmages will come to Sea Gate the next day.
Noyan realizes Gideon's last question about Cosi and Ula was a hint that he had been manipulated by his own pride.
events.quote: Noyan Dar's elation turned into a very flat stare.

relations.note: Noyan leads and trains the initiates at his retreat.
relations.quote: I was told you were the head of an elite elementalist force.

relations.note: After the demonstration Noyan agrees to bring the roilmages to fight with Gideon at Sea Gate.
relations.quote: We would love to have all of you at Sea Gate with us.

relations.note: Noyan created the retreat at Coralhelm and wrote the litany the initiates use.
relations.quote: The fact that he was the one responsible for creating the retreat

relations.note: In the story, Cosi tricks Ula into pursuing a pearl and frees him from the sneeze.
relations.quote: Cosi convinces Ula that there is a powerful magical pearl, hidden deep in the heart of the ocean.
